authorization.scope: Permit only the universal four-hour ZN-direction rule as an exploratory Milestone 5 candidate while retaining every other restriction.
authorization.verbatim: Approved. Amend the research contract only to permit the universal four-hour ZN-direction rule as an exploratory Milestone 5 candidate. Retain every other restriction, freeze the rule without retuning, keep 2024 untouched until Milestone 6, and keep 2025 locked.

feature.instrument_semantics: Continuous CME 10-year Treasury-note futures price proxy. It is not an observed nominal or real Treasury yield.

interpretation.negative_price_change: Upward nominal-yield pressure proxy; bearish gold bias.
interpretation.positive_price_change: Downward nominal-yield pressure proxy; bullish gold bias.

no_bias_conditions: raw percent change is absent or non-finite
source state or four-hour change is not READY
current or reference observation is stale
four-hour comparison crosses a continuous-contract roll
feature was not available by the decision timestamp
prohibited_substitutions: macro, positioning, event, session, liquidity, or structure gate

chronological_validation_gate.comparison: Evaluate the frozen selector separately for London and New York against the better of the same-session ALWAYS_LONG and ALWAYS_SHORT controls over calendar 2024.
chronological_validation_gate.cost_robustness: At 1.5 times every frozen spread, slippage, and commission cost, each session selector must retain positive mean net P&L.
chronological_validation_gate.mapping_consistency: For each session, both POSITIVE-to-LONG and NEGATIVE-to-SHORT validation cells must have positive mean net return after frozen costs.
chronological_validation_gate.primary_pass_condition: For each session, mean net return must be above zero, profit factor must exceed one, and mean net return must exceed the better same-period unconditional directional control.
chronological_validation_gate.temporal_stability: Each session selector must have positive mean net return in both chronological halves of calendar 2024.
chronological_validation_gate.uncertainty: Report deterministic ISO-week cluster bootstrap 95 percent intervals; the interval is diagnostic and is not an independently adjustable threshold.
chronological_validation_gate.verdict_policy: Every gate must pass. Failure rejects this frozen candidate; 2024 may not be used to rename, retune, or replace it.

development_reporting.bootstrap_seed: SHA-256 of case-specification manifest hash, session code, and selector code
metrics: mean and median net P&L per ounce
mean net return in basis points
results by year and chronological half
development_reporting.purpose: Describe the already frozen selector on development data only. These results cannot change the rule and do not validate an edge.
